strong_version_needed.f590a5d5-d592-5734-bffd-0936ec276c4b: Each per-sense argument keeps both act premises in its one sense (IN-ACT_1). The weak IN-ACT_3 mover premise with IN-ACT_1 non-simultaneity is the mixed reading, which the TERM-SENSE-FORKS-2-CONTROLS model refutes.
